title: Integrated single-cell and immune profiling of the human brain in refractory epilepsy
geo_processed_format: 10x Matrix Market files in RAW.tar plus processed Seurat RDS; no h5ad
study_notes: 11 fresh surgical cortical samples from six drug-resistant epilepsy donors; 85,780 cells after QC. Supplementary Table S5 identifies 2/6 donors as FCD IIB (P2 and P3); the other diagnoses are R OLE, TLE, SWS, and SRFSE. Per-donor age, sex, seizure-onset, surgery, and histopathology have been added to sample_metadata and tissue_metadata.
